name: Financial Instrument 106
definition: Security that is a sub-set of an investment fund, and is governed by the same investment fund policy, eg, dividend option or valuation currency.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of a security by an ISIN.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the financial instrument in free format text.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Financial Instrument Short Name (FISN) expressed in conformance with the ISO 18774 standard.

SupplementaryIdentification.name: Supplementary Identification
SupplementaryIdentification.definition: Additional information about a financial instrument to help identify the instrument.

DenominationCurrency.name: Denomination Currency
DenominationCurrency.definition: Currency in which a security is issued or redenominated.

ClassType.name: Class Type
ClassType.definition: Features of units offered by a fund. For example, a unit may have a specific load structure, eg, front end or back end, an income policy, eg, pay out or accumulate, or a trailer policy, eg, with or without. Fund classes are typically denoted by a single character, eg, 'Class A', 'Class 2'.

SecuritiesForm.name: Securities Form
SecuritiesForm.definition: Form, ie, ownership, of the security, eg, registered or bearer.

DistributionPolicy.name: Distribution Policy
DistributionPolicy.definition: Income policy relating to a class type, ie, if income is paid out or retained in the fund.

DualFundIndicator.name: Dual Fund Indicator
DualFundIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the fund has two prices.

ProductGroup.name: Product Group
ProductGroup.definition: Company specific description of a group of funds.

SeriesIdentification.name: Series Identification
SeriesIdentification.definition: Source of the identification, that is, domestic (national) or proprietary.

FinancialInstrumentIdentificationGuideli.definition: It is recommended that ISIN be used in Identification\SecurityIdentification3Choice.
